itemized.notes: ALL THREE itemized pages are typed LANDSCAPE attachments (poppler renders them portrait with the text turned 90 degrees; they were rotated for reading). GEOMETRY IS DELIBERATELY OMITTED on every row of this filing: converting a row band back into portrait-page percentages could not be done to the required precision, and a wrong pointer is worse than none. Schedule A supplies NO ADDRESSES AT ALL - the Complete Mailing Address column is empty on both pages (a filer omission, not a redaction), so every donor_city/donor_state is blank. Schedule B carries a dedicated asterisk column with the legend '* In Kind' at the foot; SIX expenditure rows are asterisked and are recorded in_kind. Schedule A prints the SAME '* In Kind' legend but NO asterisk is visible against any contribution row at 300 dpi, so no contribution is flagged in_kind - however five Schedule A amounts (300.00, 11.95 twice, 500.00, 1,500.00, 2,625.00) recur exactly as asterisked Schedule B rows, which a human may want to look at. Two dates are malformed and left blank: '09/12806' on Schedule A and '19/19/06' on Schedule B. One Schedule A date is printed '6/22/2006' among September entries - well-formed, so kept VERBATIM as a filer typo. One Schedule A row is an aggregate ('Various -- GOP Meeting'), and two are candidate self-LOANs.
